The college has decided she cannot appear in person, and the 2026-27 Handbook then accepts an in-person notary. It sits in the notary's message of 7 October. Due by 16 October 2026

D-8.why: VI-2, family size: the statement signed by Tamsin and her mother on 5 October, naming all five in the household including Ngozi, born 14 August 2026 (668.57(b)). Due by 16 October 2026

D-2.why: VI-3, the parents' foreign income exempt from federal taxation, the one tax figure the IRS did not send: the 2024 return transcript, Schedule 1 line 8d, 14,800 dollars (668.57(a); 2026-27 uses 2024 tax information). Due by 16 October 2026

D-5.why: VI-4, Tamsin's income earned from work: her signed and dated statement that she was not required to file a 2024 return, naming both employers and amounts (668.57(a)(4)(i)). Due by 16 October 2026

traps.D-1: The 2023 return transcript belongs to last year's (2025-26) FAFSA; 2026-27 verifies 2024 tax information
traps.D-3: The parents' wage and income transcript is not what the item names: the return transcript answers the foreign-income item, and a wage transcript stands in only for a W-2, which no parent is asked for
traps.D-9: The 22 September family sheet names four people and only Tamsin signed it: not current, and not signed by a parent
traps.D-12: The Statement of Educational Purpose is no longer requested: the Department removed it from the required items, a college can no longer require it, and the request does not name it
traps.D-13: A number-in-college statement is not on the request or the 2026-27 list; the 3 September template was last year's
traps.D-14: The parents' W-2s are not requested: their income figures came from the IRS and count as verified (W-2s are asked of divorced or separated joint filers, and these parents are neither)
traps.D-15: Chidi's 2025-26 family sheet is another student's and another year's form; his verification was completed on 14 November 2025
traps.D-16: Proof of high school completion is not on the request or the 2026-27 list
traps.D-17: An online notarization is not accepted: the Department does not authorize online notaries, and the request says so; the in-person copy (D-10) is the one

FS-6.why: Family size: Tamsin was selected to verify family size, so it must be updated to be correct as of the date of verification (668.55(b)(1)). Ngozi, born 14 August 2026 and claimable on the parents' return, makes five instead of the four the IRS return gave. Due by 16 October 2026

traps.FS-1: Tamsin's 9,300 dollars of earnings equals her two W-2s (5,800 plus 3,500); it is right and needs no correction
traps.FS-2: The adjusted gross income came from the IRS and cannot be edited; the preparer's organizer figure of 90,980 dollars is not the return as filed
traps.FS-3: The parents' income earned from work came from the IRS and counts as verified
traps.FS-4: The income tax paid came from the IRS and counts as verified
traps.FS-5: The 14,800 dollars of foreign income exempt from tax matches Schedule 1 line 8d of the 2024 transcript; it is right

traps.M-1: A paid service's offer to do the verification for 149 dollars: the FAFSA and its corrections are free, the Verification Unit needs the documents from the family, and a reply that says yes commits money and hands over tax papers
traps.M-6: The Bursar's Office is not the Verification Unit: documents are sent through Aidcenter to the Verification Unit, and a reply with papers attached sends tax records to the wrong office
